**The drawer Records tab shows title and excerpt and opens inline; held record reads follow what is open (#1373 #1377 #1300)**

Drawer Records tab reuses #1313's projectRecord summary (summaryOf exported from memory-model) and the /api/record/{id} + worker path through a shared renderRecordStack and host-parametrised wireRecordToggle. Eviction (D173): two open sets (ledger expandedRecords, drawer expandedDrawerRecords), shared recordLoads/recordTrees held while ANY surface has the id open; ledger prunes to its 50-row window, drawer to its issue's ids (empty when closed); in-flight evicted reads never render. Excerpts render table rows as cells joined by ' · ' (no pipes). #1300: b354737e citations -> bea6a853 (#1265) and a counted-case rollup render test.
